title: Sales & Event Operations
description:
About Optimal AI



Optimal AI is building the quality and judgment layer for AI generated code.



Optibot, our first multi-agent system, serves as thoughtful code review agents that flag issues line by line, and fix them. Optibot identifies security vulnerabilities, technical debt, and compliance risks with full codebase context, while cutting PR cycle times and improving engineering velocity. Paired with our Engineering Insights Platform, teams get real-time analytics on code quality and productivity across every repo.



We're trusted by engineering teams at Bear Robotics, LG, MongoDB, MPulse, Prometric, and more. Backed by Act One ventures and Chingona Ventures, with a team of serial exited entrepreneurs, YCombinator, McKinsey and Boeing alums.



The Role

We're building out our events and GTM engine and we need a sharp, creative operator to own it. You'll be responsible for making sure our events, engineering leader dinners, virtual shows, and community gatherings are consistently full, high-quality, and running like clockwork. You'll also support our outbound pipeline with lead research, copywriting, videos and campaign execution. You will be expected to work Pacific hours, synced with our San Francisco HQ.



This role sits at the intersection of events, sales ops, and video content. If you love building systems, writing copy that converts, and making things look great, this is your seat.



How we work

? High ownership, high output. Everyone on the team owns outcomes end-to-end. We work best with individuals who are precise, fast, and great at unblocking themselves.

? Critical feedback is a gift. We give feedback directly and receive it without ego. Don't take it personally. It's how we get better.

? Customer-obsessed. We make an effort to talk to all our customers and relentlessly provide value to each of them.



What You'll Do:



Events

- Collaborate on end-to-end logistics for our dinner series and virtual events like venue coordination, getting guest lists sorted, RSVPs, run of show, name tags, and day-of execution.

- Use Clay, Heyreach, Instantly, Luma and other lead generation tools to build targeted invite lists and fill rooms consistently.

- Write outreach copy and event messaging that gets people to show up.

- Cold calling event attendees to confirm attendance and get pre calls booked



Content & Design

- Edit video content for LinkedIn, YouTube, and event recaps using CapCut, Descript, Premiere Pro or any video editor to produce high quality content…

- Create high-quality graphics, social assets, and event visuals using Canva, Gemini’s Nano Banana, and other AI tools.

- Write copy for campaigns, event invites, LinkedIn posts, and Instantly/Heyreach outbound sequences.



Sales & Pipeline Support

- Build lead lists and prospect using Clay, Evaboot and similar tools

- Do lead research of deals in our pipeline that we would like to multithread into by finding other champions and mapping out the org and their pains using tools like Sales Navigator and AI like Claude.

- Answering/replying to messages and
s from campaigns we are running in Heyreach and Instantly with the goal of getting demos booked in the calendar. 

- Support outbound campaigns across
 and LinkedIn (managing sequences, tracking performance, flagging what's working)

- Keep the CRM clean by updating records, flagging follow-ups, tracking pipeline activity



What We're Looking For

- 1–3 years in events, sales ops, marketing coordination, or a similar fast-paced role

- Hands-on experience with Clay or similar lead gen/data enrichment tools

- Video editing skills with CapCut, Descript, Premiere pro, or similar 

- Strong copywriting and messaging skills (ie: you can write an invite that gets a yes)

- Comfortable with AI tools (Canva, Gemini, ChatGPT, and whatever ships next)

- PST availability: you need to overlap with our North American team during core hours

- Highly organized, proactive, and able to juggle multiple events and campaigns at once

- Startup experience or comfort with ambiguity is a strong plus

This is a long-term opportunity for someone who enjoys learning, solving problems, and improving their skills every day.



You do not need to be an expert today. We are looking for someone who is motivated, dependable, and excited to learn.



The most important requirement is a strong desire to become an After Effects expert.



What We Are Looking For:

• Reliable and dependable

• Good communication skills

• Able to follow instructions

• Comfortable asking questions when needed

• Willing to learn (mostly) independently

• Interested in a long-term career in motion graphics

• Enjoys using AI tools to learn faster, solve problems, and generate graphics.



We expect the person we hire to spend a significant amount of time learning Adobe After Effects and Adobe Photoshop.



Daily Responsibilities:

• Check in through chat at the beginning of each workday is required. I don't want to use Timeproof unless necessary.

• Check out through chat at the end of each workday.

• Submit a daily report showing what you learned, created, or worked on.

• Include links to tutorials, resources, or projects completed during the day. We'll provide you with a Box.com account.

• Create motion graphic advertisements and animation projects.

• Continue learning new After Effects techniques and workflows.



First Few Weeks:

During the first few weeks, your main goal will be learning and practicing Adobe After Effects.



You will follow online tutorials (YouTube, chatgpt, other online resources), complete exercises (AI can help you learn faster), and build projects while learning. You should be familiar and comfortable with Keyframes, Layers, Animation basics, Rendering and exporting, and Project organization. Multiple 10-second projects are expected each week during this stage.



Next Stage:

As your skills improve, you will begin creating original motion graphics without relying on step-by-step tutorials. You will be able to build / modify assets in Adobe Photoshop or using AI that are used in your motion graphic animations. You should be comfortable with Easy Easing, Masks, Blend Modes, Motion design principles, and Professional workflows. Multiple 10-second projects will continue to be expected each week.



Long-Term Growth:

Over time, the goal is to become an advanced After Effects designer. You will be able to recreate almost any type of commercial motion graphic you see. You know how to build advanced projects from scratch, create reusable After Effects templates, work with expressions, build complex pre-compositions, design projects for multiple screen sizes and aspect ratios, create graphics using AI-generated and custom-built assets.



As your skills continue to grow, you will also learn Blender, Video Copilot Element 3D, and other 3D animation and motion design workflows.



Requirements:

• Your own computer. It needs to be able to run Adobe After Effects 2026.

• Internet connection. We will ask you about your speed and how frequently you have outages.

• Interest in learning and using AI tools.



After you are hired, we'll provide an Adobe license and access to share files on Box.com. 



Work Schedule:

The first few days of training and onboarding will be completed during our time zone (Mountain Time Zone) of the United States. We're based in Utah. Once training and onboarding is completed, expectations are understood, and communication systems are established, you can transition to working Philippine hours.



Please include a portfolio, website, demo reel, or examples of your motion graphics work. Applications without examples of any type of graphics work will not be considered.



If you advance to the interview process, you will be required to complete a 5 to 10 minute test in After Effects during the interview process with us so we can evaluate your current level of skill in After Effects. This will be done during the video call interview. We will share monitors and allow you to have keyboard and mouse control temporarily to do this test. This test will be on a PC (Windows 11) with After Effects 2026. We will show you a completed motion graphic 10-second animation and give you the assets (images/videos) required to recreate this animation. You will be given 5 to 10 minutes to recreate the completed animation.



Application Instructions:

To confirm that you read this entire job posting, begin your application with the words: "AE is After Effects".



Long-Term Opportunity:

We are looking for someone to grow with our company for years, not weeks or months. The right person can eventually become our Lead Template Designer and help build our growing motion graphics template library.



Compensation:

Starting salary: $1,200 - $2,000 USD per month, depending on experience, skill level, and portfolio. This amount does not include any additional money to cover the 2% forex fee. Payment will be processed through Easypay / Payoneer.



Annual performance reviews and salary increases are available as skills improve and responsibilities grow.

s: Managing a busy inbox and phone line to answer client questions about policies, migrations, claims, sign-ups, refunds, and cancellations quickly and on time.

title: Junior Technical QA Associate — Architecture / Engineering Background

# Junior Technical QA Associate — Architecture / Engineering Background



**Fully Remote | Philippines | Contractor Role**



If you are eager to learn, detail-oriented, and excited to work on the future of how buildings are designed, built, analyzed, and operated, we would love to meet you.



Oliant is looking for smart, motivated fresh graduates with a background in **Architecture, Civil Engineering, or Mechanical Engineering** to join our remote delivery team. This is a great opportunity for someone starting their career who wants to gain real-world experience working with construction drawings, 3D models, AI-assisted workflows, quality assurance, and digital project delivery.



You do not need years of experience. What matters most is that you are reliable, adaptable, curious, and willing to learn fast.



## About the Role



As a **Junior Technical QA Associate**, you will support project delivery by reviewing, tagging, labeling, validating, and organizing technical information related to construction drawings, 3D models, and AI-assisted workflows.



You will work closely with team leads, QA specialists, and project delivery teams to ensure that the work we deliver is accurate, consistent, and useful to our customers from day one.



This role is ideal for a recent graduate who wants to start their career in a modern, international, technology-driven environment.



## What You’ll Do



Your responsibilities may include:



* Review and interpret **2D construction drawings**.

* Navigate and understand **3D models**.

* Perform AI tagging, labeling, data validation, and quality assurance tasks.

* Check project information for accuracy, completeness, and consistency.

* Follow structured workflows and quality guidelines.

* Help identify errors, inconsistencies, or missing information.

* Collaborate with team leads and other remote tea
mbers.

* Learn new tools, processes, and project requirements quickly.

* Support continuous improvement by giving feedback on processes and workflows.



## You Should Apply If



You should apply if:



* You have a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in **Architecture, Civil Engineering, or Mechanical Engineering**.

* You have a good understanding of reading **2D construction drawings**.

* You are comfortable learning how to navigate **3D models**.

* You have strong English communication skills.

* You are detail-oriented and take pride in accurate work.

* You are adaptable, responsible, and have a strong work ethic.

* You are comfortable working remotely.

* You want your skills, effort, and contributions to drive your growth.

* You are excited to work with AI-assisted tools and modern digital workflows.



## Experience Level



This is an **entry-level role**. Fresh graduates are welcome.



Previous experience with BIM, Revit, Navisworks, AutoCAD, construction documentation, QA, data labeling, or AI-related workflows is helpful, but not required.



We are more interested in your ability to learn, communicate, focus, and improve.



## Our Culture



At Oliant, we believe in building strong remote teams based on trust, ownership, communication, and continuous learning.



We value people who are proactive, honest, curious, and willing to take responsibility for their work. You will not be expected to know everything on day one, but you will be expected to learn, ask questions, improve, and contribute.



We support each other. If something is unclear, if a process breaks, or if you need help, the team will be there to help you get back on track.



We also believe in feedback. Clear, respectful, and direct feedback helps everyone grow faster. Good ideas are judged by their value, not by someone’s title or seniority.



## Growth Opportunity



This role is designed as a strong starting point for fresh graduates.



As you prove your reliability, quality, communication, and ability to understand technical work, there will be opportunities for compensation reviews and growth within the team.



Performance and compensation are reviewed after the initial period and then periodically based on quality, reliability, communication, ownership, and business needs.



## Role Details



* **Location:** Fully remote, Philippines

* **Type:** Contractor

* **Schedule:** Full-time

* **Weekend availability:** May be required depending on project needs

* **Start:** As soon as possible



## How to Apply



Please send your resume and a short introduction telling us:



1. Your degree and university.

2. Any experience you have with construction drawings, 3D models, BIM, AutoCAD, Revit, Navisworks, or similar tools.

3. Your English communication level.

4. Why you are interested in this role.



We are looking for smart, reliable people who want to grow. If that sounds like you, we would love to hear from you.

title: Real Estate Lead Generation VA | Base + Commission | Long-Term Role
description:
Top performers made $9,950 in a single quarter. Here's how.

The machine is already built. Active Meta ads are running. A fully loaded GoHighLevel CRM with scripts and objection handlers is ready to go. A live funnel with leads already coming in is waiting. All deal attribution is tracked with timestamps — no gray area, no guesswork.

Your job is to find qualified leads, book appointments, and work the system consistently. The pipeline is warm and you can be making calls in week one. Everything else is already in place.



About This Opportunity

Hi, I'm Jaz Sale — a licensed real estate agent based in Oklahoma City, active investor, and STR operator. I'm looking for a reliable, self-motivated Virtual Assistant to join my team long-term.

This is a pure outbound sales role. Your primary job is to find motivated sellers and qualified buyers through cold outreach — expired listings, FSBOs, circle prospecting, and direct cold calling — and book them as qualified appointments on my calendar.You will also follow up with warm inbound leads coming in from my social media and Meta ads.

But make no mistake — this role is built for someone who loves the hunt. If you're not comfortable picking up the phone and calling strangers every single day, this is not the right fit.



What a Qualified Lead Looks Like

A qualified lead is someone who has a real need — buying or selling in OKC in the next 30-90 days — has been contacted by you, is logged in GoHighLevel, and has agreed to a scheduled appointment with me.

You do not get credit for a name and number. You get credit for a booked, qualified conversation.



Compensation

Strong performers earned $9,950 in a single quarter. Here's the breakdown:

Example — Strong Quarter (8 deals at Tier 3):

8 × $800 = $6,400 + $1,500 quarterly bonus + $1,050 base = $9,950

Per-Deal Commission — Tiered by Performance:



Starter — Deal 1 — $400

Growing — Deals 2-5 — $650

Established — Deal 6+ — $800



Quarterly Production Bonuses:



Close 3 deals in a quarter  +$500

Close 5 deals in a quarter  +$1,000

Close 8+ deals in a quarter  +$1,500



Base Pay: $350/month

This is your runway while your pipeline builds — not your ceiling. The commission is where the real earning potential lives and it compounds fast once the pipeline is moving.



What You'll Be Doing



Prospect for motivated sellers daily — expired listings, FSBOs, circle prospecting, cold outreach

Generate and follow up with buyer leads across multiple channels

Follow up with warm inbound leads from social media and Meta ads

Qualify leads and book appointments directly on my calendar

Log all activity in GoHighLevel CRM — full training provided

Nurture cold leads until they are ready to move

Communicate professionally on behalf of my brand at all times

To apply — send a message through this platform with one sentence telling me why outbound sales is the right fit for you. If your background looks like a match I will reach out within 24 hours with next steps including a short video and application form. We respond fast to candidates who are serious





Activity Expectations

This role has a minimum daily floor — not a target, a floor.



First 30 days: 50+ outbound touches per day minimum while learning the scripts and system

After 30 days: 75+ daily touches minimum — every single day



Outbound touches include cold calls, texts, DMs, and
s combined. If you have done real outbound sales before this is completely normal. If this sounds like a lot this role probably is not the right fit.



Who We're Looking For



Experience in real estate lead gen, cold calling, or outbound sales — strongly preferred

Comfortable picking up the phone and calling strangers every single day without being asked

Self-directed — you manage your own time and hit your numbers without being chased

Reliable internet connection and a quiet workspace for calls

GoHighLevel or similar CRM experience is a plus

Strong written and verbal English communication

Honest about what you know and hungry to learn what you don't





A Few Things to Know Upfront

Real estate deals take 30-60 days to close from when a lead is set. Strong performers typically see their first commission hit by week six — and the pipeline compounds from there. The base pay is your runway while that first cycle plays out. The people who stay consistent are the ones who see it pay off fast.

On the 1099 arrangement — this is an independent contractor role and that is intentional. 1099 means you control your schedule, your upside is completely uncapped, and there is no ceiling a W-2 would put on your earnings. The people who thrive here treat this like their own business — because it is.

Strong performers will be considered for expanded roles and higher earning potential over time. This is a long-term opportunity, not a short contract.



Important Details



Deal credit is clearly defined — you make first contact, log it in GoHighLevel, and book a qualified appointment that leads to a close. All tracked with timestamps. No gray area.

1099 independent contractor arrangement

You set your own schedule — we care about results, not hours

Scripts and objection handlers provided — you are not starting from scratch

Full GoHighLevel CRM training included





How to Apply — Two Steps, Both Required

We are reviewing the first 20 qualified applications. This posting comes down the moment we find the right candidate — not on a schedule. Don't wait.

Who are you?

What is your sales or real estate experience?

Why is this role a good fit for you right now?



No scripts, no heavy editing — just talk directly. Paste your Loom link in your application.

Step 2: Complete our short 3-question application here: [INSERT TYPEFORM LINK]

After applying the next step is a short intro call with a live roleplay. Think of it as your audition for a spot on a winning team — not a test to screen you out. The candidates who lean into it are the ones who get hired. Come ready to pitch and we will respond fast.

title: Online Business Manager with GHL Experience
description:

We are a Philippines-based AI and automation agency delivering done-for-you GoHighLevel builds, CRM buildouts, and workflow automation for US-based clients on monthly retainers. We run a lean, remote team of IT specialists and we are growing. This role exists because the CEO needs to stop being the glue holding daily operations together.



What this role is NOT:

Not a VA role

Not a task-taker

Not someone who waits to be told what to do



What this role IS:

You are the person who makes sure the team is doing what they said they would do — and that clients feel it. You own the accountability layer between the CEO and the team. You don't build the automations. You make sure the people building them are on track, on time, and delivering.



Your core responsibilities:

Team Accountability

Monitor daily task completion across all active client accounts in ClickUp

Run weekly team check-ins and flag blockers before they become client problems

Track IT team utilization — who is deployed, who is idle, and why

Ensure deliverables are moving without the CEO following up

Client Delivery Oversight

Review weekly output across all MRC accounts — not technically, but logistically

Flag anything that looks off-track to the CEO before the client notices

Coordinate between IT staff and client timelines

Ensure SOPs are being followed on every active account

Marketing Doer Oversight

Check that weekly content outputs are completed on time

Review against the agreed content plan — not for creative quality, but for completion and consistency

Flag missed deadlines or gaps to the CEO

Internal Ops

Maintain and update SOPs in ClickUp as processes change

Document decisions, role responsibilities, and recurring workflows

Identify gaps in process before they become recurring problems



What we need from you — by milestone:

Week 1

Full orientation on all active clients, team structure, and ClickUp setup

Shadow CEO on one internal team check-in

Audit current ClickUp task completion across all active accounts and deliver a gap report

Week 4

Running weekly team accountability check independently — no CEO involvement

First delivery health report submitted covering all MRC accounts

At least one SOP documented from scratch

Month 3

CEO is no longer the daily escalation point for team task follow-ups

All active client accounts have a documented delivery tracker updated weekly

Marketing doer output reviewed weekly with a summary to CEO

At least 3 SOPs documented and actively in use



You are the right person if:

You have 2–4 years experience in digital agency ops, online business management, or remote team coordination

You have used ClickUp or similar project management tools extensively

You are comfortable holding people accountable without being their friend about it

You can communicate clearly in English — written and verbal

You are self-directed — you do not need to be micromanaged

You have worked with or understand GHL, CRM, or marketing automation at a basic level (you don't need to build it — you need to understand what the team is building)

title: Cold Calling Representative
description:

Job Title: Cold Calling Representative — Commercial Outreach (B2B Appointment Setter)

Type: Full-time, 40 hours/week

Pay: $150/week

Hours: Monday–Friday, US Eastern Time business hours

About the Role

We're an exterior cleaning company based in Florida called The Wash Experts we specialize in commericial pressure washing, window cleaning, and building washing. We're hiring a confident, well-spoken cold caller to reach out to commercial businesses — property managers, retail storefronts, restaurants, plazas, HOAs, and similar — to introduce our services and secure quote opportunities.

A supportive team that wants you to win

Client Success & Account Management



- Own the end-to-end customer journey for assigned accounts, from onboarding through renewal and upsell.

- Handle inbound customer queries and escalations with a solutions-first approach.

- Maintain accurate records across CRM and project tools.

- Help identify opportunities to automate and improve sales processes, including lead capture, follow-up sequences, CRM workflows, reporting, and handoffs between marketing and sales.

- Document repeatable sales and client success workflows so they can be improved, delegated, and automated over time.



Cross-functional Collaboration



- Work closely with marketing to align outreach with campaign activity and content calendars.

- Support the development of sales enablement materials and client-facing talk tracks.





Skills & Experience



Required

- 2 to 4 years in a customer success, account management, or inside sales role.

- Proven track record managing a book of business and hitting conversion or retention targets.

- Experience running outbound sales sequences 
, LinkedIn) and managing pipeline in a CRM.

- Exceptional written English, natural, polished, and persuasive across
, social, and client-facing copy. AI tools may be used to support output, but candidates must be able to write well on their own.

- Campaign management experience, with the ability to plan, execute, and report on multi-channel marketing or outreach campaigns end to end.

- Comfortable thinking in systems — turning repeated sales, follow-up, and client success tasks into documented workflows, templates, and automations.

- Strong verbal communicator, confident in customer-facing conversations and discovery calls.

- Comfortable working in a fast-paced, project-driven environment.

- Organised, self-directed, and able to manage multiple accounts simultaneously.



Nice to Have

You use LLMs (Claude, ChatGPT, or similar) to produce written content at volume and edit the output so it sounds human, on-brand, and worth reading

**Required Experience & Skills**



 · 3+ years in digital marketing, content production, or a marketing execution role supporting US clients or brands

 · Preferred: Canva AI, Midjourney, Adobe Firefly, Semrush or Ahrefs, Buffer/Later or similar scheduling platform, Zapier or Make,  · Video editing experience,
 marketing platforms





**About Glass Design**



Life is too short to not love what you do and who you do it with.



Glass Design is a second-generation, family-owned company that has served Southwest Florida since 1996. We are passionate about beautiful design, exceptional customer experiences, and building a team that genuinely loves what they do — wherever in the world they are based.



We run on EOS and live our core values every day:



We Choose Optimism · We Embrace Continuous Learning · We Relentlessly Pursue Improvement · We Get Sh!t Done · We Do the Right Thing

mber of this team and the work shows it.

mbers

mber who understands the current workflow

title: Remote Production Manager — Custom Pool Construction (U.S. Company)
description:
The short version

We build custom in-ground pools, and we're very good at building them. What we need now is someone who makes sure every job flows — that we're always planning two and three steps ahead, that materials and crews and inspections are lined up before they're needed, and that no job ever sits waiting on something we should have seen coming.

You won't be on the job site. You'll be the brain behind it — running the schedule, owning our project software, keeping the owner informed, and catching cost problems before they cost us. If you understand how construction actually works and you're the kind of person who can't stand a missed deadline or a sloppy record, keep reading.



What you'll own

The flow of every job. You keep the master construction schedule current across all active builds, and you maintain a rolling 2–3 week lookahead so the crew always has what they need before they need it. Materials ordered ahead. Subs booked ahead. Inspections sequenced ahead. Your job is simple to state and hard to do: no job ever waits.

The daily pulse. You run a daily huddle with the team and pull in, for every job: where it stands, what's blocking us, and what's next. You turn that into a clear report so the owner can see everything from a high level and trust it's handled.

Our system of record (JobTread). You own it. Daily logs filled in every day. Vendor communication routed and logged. Every job's status, costs, and schedule reflecting reality. You keep it clean without being asked twice.

Cost control. When bills and expenses come in, you verify them against the job's scope and budget before they go to accounting. You'll know a job well enough to catch when an invoice doesn't match what was actually built or authorized. You're our first line of defense on cost — our accountant handles payment, you make sure the number is right.



Who you are



You understand how construction actually gets built — phases, sequencing, what has to happen before what.

You can read an estimate and spot when an invoice is wrong — quantities, unit costs, scope. This is the most important thing on this list.

You're relentless about planning ahead. Surprises and last-minute scrambles genuinely bother you.

You're organized to a fault and you keep systems clean.

You communicate clearly in written English and your reports are easy to read.

You hold people to their commitments — crews and vendors — without drama.

You're calm when things go sideways and you have good judgment about what to handle vs. what to flag.



Who you're not

This is not a calendar-keeping or data-entry job. If you've only ever scheduled tasks without understanding the work behind them, this isn't the right fit. We need someone who knows the difference between a $9,000 plaster invoice that makes sense and one that doesn't.



Requirements



Reliable overlap with U.S. Central Time working hours (this is why we prefer Latin America)

Strong written and spoken English

Construction project management, production, or estimating background

Comfort living inside project-management software all day (we use JobTread — experience is a plus, aptitude is a must)

Stable internet and a quiet space for daily video huddles



Nice to have



Experience in residential construction, pools, or trades

Familiarity with scheduling / Gantt tools and job-cost management

Prior experience working remotely with a U.S. company





Why this role is good



You'll have real ownership — this isn't busywork, it's the seat that keeps the whole operation running.

You report directly to the owner and your work is visible and valued.

Long-term, stable role with a growing company that invests in good systems and good people.





How to apply

Send your resume and a short note (a few sentences is fine) answering this:



Tell me about a time you caught a problem before it became expensive or caused a delay — a billing error, a material that wasn't ordered in time, a step nobody planned for. What did you notice, and what did you do?



We read every one of these, and it tells us more than a resume does.

title: Full-time AI Video Editor
description:
Summary

PLEASE DON'T APPLY UNLESS YOU ARE WILLING TO WORK FULL TIME

About TryAIAds:



TryAIAds is the AI-powered ad production arm of MTRX Media. We produce over 75 AI video ads in 7 days for e-commerce brands generating 7-8 figures. While MTRX handles high-production creative, TryAIAds is a different beast — pure speed, pure output, pure hunger.



Go to 
 — watch the work. Your job is to match that quality and beat it.



The Role:



Full-time AI Video Editor. You generate and edit high-quality AI video ad concepts at pace. The formats you'll be producing daily:



AI Podcasts — realistic two-person podcast conversations selling a product

AI Debates — split-screen argument-style ads with opposing takes

AI Explainer Videos — animated or motion-graphic breakdowns of product mechanisms

AI UGC / Talking Head — single-person direct-to-camera style ads

AI Fruit Videos — satisfying visual product demos with AI-generated imagery





You need to be as comfortable prompting Kling as you are cutting in Premiere.



Responsibilities:





Produce 6 concepts per week at the quality level shown on tryaiads.ai (1 concept = 1 original video + 4 hook variants)

Work with AI video generation tools daily — Kling 3.0, Veo 3.1, Higgsfield, Grok Imagine — and know when to use which tool for which output

Edit and polish AI-generated footage into finished ads — pacing, text overlays, music, transitions, sound design

Troubleshoot AI outputs systematically — when a generation comes back wrong (bad lip sync, weird hands, off-brand tone), you diagnose the prompt, adjust the approach, and fix it. You don't just re-roll and hope

Build and refine prompt templates that consistently produce usable outputs — reduce the randomness, increase the hit rate

Constantly test new AI tools and techniques. This space changes weekly. If you're not experimenting, you're falling behind





Ideal Persona:



Minimum 2 years of video editing experience (Premiere, After Effects, CapCut, or equivalent)

Hands-on experience with at least 2 AI video generation tools (Kling, Runway, Pika, Veo, Higgsfield, Sora, or similar)

Systems thinker — when something produces bad output, you build a process so it doesn't happen again. You don't just use tools, you create workflows

Strong understanding of paid media and what makes ads convert on
 and TikTok

Detail-oriented, organised, and capable of managing multiple brands simultaneously

Comfortable working weekends on editing and reviews — our editing team runs 7 days

Previous agency experience preferred





What We Don't Want:



Someone who treats AI tools as a magic button. If you think prompting is just typing "make me a video" and hoping for the best, this isn't for you

Someone who waits to be told what to do. If something's broken, you fix it. If something could be better, you say it. If you're idle, you find work

Someone who can't handle pace. We deliver 75 ads in 7 days. That's not a target, that's the minimum





The Culture:



This isn't a corporate agency gig. At TryAIAds we want to be the best, the growth potential here is insane.  Everyone here is trying to be the best at what they do and moves like it.



Relentless output: You should scare people with how much you get done. If someone isn't asking "how does this person produce this much" — you're not moving fast enough



Zero excuses: Tool went down? Find another one. Prompt didn't work? Fix it and move on. Brand sent bad assets? Solve it yourself before you flag it. This is an anti-victim zone



Obsessed with the craft: You watch AI demos for fun. You test new tools on your own time. You have opinions about which model generates better lip sync. If AI video isn't something you genuinely care about, you'll get left behind by someone who does



Speak up or get left behind: If you've got an idea, say it. If you disagree with something, say it. Quiet people who wait to be asked don't last here. Personality and directness are valued over politeness



Compete with yourself: Every week your output should be better than last week. Better quality, faster turnaround, cleaner prompts. The bar moves constantly and you should be the one moving it



To Apply:



Reply with 'Yellow' — if you don't, your application won't be looked at

Send an example of AI videos you've made — screen recordings, portfolio links, Google Drive folder, whatever you've got. If you haven't made any AI video work, don't apply

Please give your best and keep in mind that answers generated by AI will lead to disqualification (ironic ik)

A short weekly recap.

What posted, what worked, what didn’t, what we’re testing next.

Once the above is humming, we expand into YouTube Shorts and TikTok. You’ll help design that rollout.

Lead time matters. Content should be drafted, reviewed, and scheduled well ahead of posting — not assembled the day it goes out. I’ll deliver a weekly source pack (talks, drafts, clips, themes) by Monday. You won’t be sourcing raw material on the clock, and I expect a buffer of approved content ready to go at all times.

TOOLS YOU’LL USE

Canva, CapCut, Buffer or Later, an
 platform (Kit, Beehiiv, or similar). Comfort with at least two is expected. Curiosity to pick up the rest is non-negotiable.

WHO YOU ARE

— You create. Natively, regularly, on at least one of Instagram, LinkedIn, or TikTok. You don’t just manage social — you make things.

— You design well. Strong eye for layout, typography, and visual hierarchy. Your carousels look intentional, not templated.

— You write in your own voice — and you can hold someone else’s without flattening it. You’ll draft captions and newsletter copy from my material, close enough that my edits are light, not rewrites. All writing must be your own. No AI-generated copy.

— You edit video. You can cut a 60-second Reel or Short from a longer talk and make it land.

— You track what’s working right now. You follow trends in format, pacing, hooks, and platform behavior — and you bring that awareness into what you create. Not chasing trends for their own sake, but knowing what’s current and adapting it to fit the brand.

— You are obsessive about brand consistency. Fonts, colors, tone, spacing — every post should feel like it came from the same hand. I’ll provide brand guidelines; you’ll internalize them and hold yourself to them without being reminded.

— You’re drawn to the ideas — negotiation, leadership, personal development, the challenge of translating academic work for a public audience. You don’t need to be an expert; you need to actually be curious.

— You ship on a schedule without being chased. You build a buffer and stay ahead of deadlines, not on top of them.

— You take feedback well, and a lot of it. Most of what you’ll hear early on is voice-calibration, not criticism.

— You’d rather build a system once than redo the same work twice.

Bonus: experience repurposing podcast or video content; you’ve worked inside an
 platform before; background in marketing, communications, design, or writing.

LOGISTICS

— Effort: 6–8 hours/week. You set your own schedule against weekly delivery dates.

— Pay: $5–10/hr USD based on experience and expertise, paid as an independent contractor. You’ll use your own equipment; AQ Consulting provides access to brand accounts and the weekly source pack. Growth bonus tied to audience milestones — we’ll define these together.

— Duration: 10 weeks to start, with strong potential to continue indefinitely.

— Cadence: one 30-minute weekly call scheduled in U.S. Eastern Time, plus async approvals within 24 hours. You must be available for this call on a consistent basis — this is not negotiable.

— Location: fully remote, open to applicants worldwide.

— Start: mid-June 2026.

— Required before start: signed Independent Contractor Agreement, mutual NDA, and IP assignment of all work product to AQ Consulting LLC.

HOW TO APPLY

 
 with the subject line:

Content Creator — [Your Name]

Include:

1. Resume or portfolio link.

2. Three work samples — one from each:

— Something in your own voice.

— Something you made in someone else’s voice or for a brand.

— One piece of repurposing — long-form turned into short-form.

Links preferred. If a piece can’t be shared publicly, describe it in 2–3 sentences.

3. A short note telling me:

— Why this role? What about this kind of work pulled you in?

— What will you bring that nobody else applying will?

Specificity over polish. A point of view over a performance. I’d rather read one paragraph that could only have been written by you than a full page of careful prose anyone could have sent.

Applications reviewed on a rolling basis. Finalists will be invited to a paid trial project ($40–60 USD) — drafting one newsletter and one Instagram carousel from source material I’ll provide — reviewed within five business days.

AQ CONSULTING LLC

This is a translation job, not a design job.



What Exists

• A complete multi-page website prototype built in HTML/CSS — homepage, books, speaking, about, contact, media, and two additional pages

A full WordPress rebuild of the approved prototype, including:

• All pages recreated to match the approved design exactly

•

Critical Technical Requirements

You must be comfortable with all of the following:

1. Staging environment setup on DreamHost — the entire site must be built in staging first. Nothing goes to the live server until I have reviewed and approved every page.

2. Staging-to-live push — when approved, you will push the staged site live using a proper migration process. Not a copy-paste rebuild on the live server.

3. Preserve domain history and SEO equity — the domain has years of authority (NY Times Bestselling Author, national TV appearances, indexed press). The push to live must preserve existing URL structure, redirects, and domain history. Nothing gets wiped.

4. WordPress page builder — Elementor Pro preferred. If you use a different builder, tell me which one and why before we start.

5. Clean, maintainable code — no bloat, no unnecessary plugins. I need to be able to manage content after launch without a developer.

• All photos, logos, and assets

• Exact hex codes, font specs, and brand rules in writing

• Written copy for every page

• A clear yes/no approval at each milestone before you proceed



How This Project Works — Milestone Structure

Payment is milestone-based. You will not be paid for the whole project upfront, and I will not ask you to build the whole site before I've seen anything.



Milestone Deliverable Approval

1 Staging environment set up, WordPress installed, homepage built to match prototype ? Yes — before proceeding

2 All remaining pages built in staging ? Yes — page by page review

Skills That Are NOT Required

• Graphic design

• Logo creation

• Copywriting

• Brand strategy

• Any creative decisions whatsoever — those are already made



About You

• You have built and launched WordPress sites from start to finish — not just assisted on a team

• You can point me to live sites you personally built (and tell me specifically what your role was)

• You communicate clearly and proactively — if something is going to take longer or you hit a blocker, you tell me before it becomes a problem

• You are available for regular check-ins during the project (not just when milestones are complete)

• You understand that "build it exactly like the prototype" means exactly that



To Apply

Please include:

6. Links to 2–3 WordPress sites you personally built — and for each one, tell me specifically what your role was (sole developer, part of a team, designer + developer, etc.)

7. Your experience with DreamHost — have you set up staging on DreamHost before? If yes, briefly describe how.

8. Your page builder of choice and why

9. Your availability — how many hours per week can you dedicate to this project, and what is your estimated timeline to complete a full multi-page site?

10. Your hourly rate



Applications that do not answer all five points will not be considered.



Design files will be shared with finalists only. Quality matters more than the lowest bid — I have been burned by cheap and fast before. I want someone who takes pride in getting it right.



This is a project-based engagement with potential for ongoing maintenance work afterward for the right person.

title: Social Media Manager / Booking Agent for Online Music Project

I’m looking for a remote VA to help build and manage an exciting new online Substack-based original music production project. The project is in the early stages so offers great opportunities for additional responsibilities and wage increases for top performance as we grow.

• Substack paid subscriptions

• Virtual concert gigs at colleges, conferences, festivals, art house theaters and other global venues 

• Sponsorships/affiliate advertising from relevant partners



The ideal candidate will be excited about collaborating with me to strategize, coordinate, and leverage my large catalogue of original rock music and virtual multimedia concert-presentations into active marketing funnels supporting these and future revenue streams.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

==================================================



• Content Calendar Management: Help me strategize, produce, and upload/distribute project assets.

• Re-purposing digital assets across relevant online platforms to drive brand awareness and bring people into my Substack ecosystem. 

• Lead Generation for Booking Virtual Gigs: Online research and cold
ing to find and nurture contacts at venues (colleges, conferences, festivals, community theaters, independent art house film centers, etc.) across the world suitable for my unique brand of virtual concert presentations. (I will provide training to teach you what these virtual concerts are, to aid you in your outreach.)

• Lead Generation to book me on podcasts for interviews/performances and find promising Substack creators for potential collaborations and crossposts.

• Research of and outreach to potential partners for sponsorships and affiliate relationships. 

• Ongoing strategy sessions: Help me track and assess current business operations and brainstorm modifications to maximize and expand revenue opportunities.

==================================================



• Creativity, initiative, and strategic thinking

• Promptness, honesty, reliability

• Strong written and verbal English communication skills

• Strong collaborative spirit to work closely with me building a new innovative online venture

• Love of music / creative arts a plus



==================================================

REQUIREMENTS & QUALIFICATIONS:

==================================================

These Zoom sessions will likely be longer in the beginning as I train you on my music, history, story, etc., and shorter down the road as you become more familiar with me and the project and are able to take full initiative.

HOURS & COMPENSATION:

==================================================



• 4 hours a day, Monday - Friday (flexible, remote)

==================================================

title: Health & Wellness Content Editor / Social Media Creator
description:
About Nosu



Nosu is a Dutch health-and-wellness brand focused on helping people reshape their relationship with sweetness, cravings, food habits, and metabolic health.



Our brand is built around the idea that long-term wellness does not come from extreme restriction or quick fixes, but from small, sustainable changes in behavior. We create content around topics such as sugar cravings, blood sugar, insulin resistance, glucose metabolism, appetite, food noise, weight management, sweet taste, reward, and healthier daily habits.



Nosu’s brand direction is modern, reliable, approachable, innovative, and grounded. Our visual identity combines vibrant organic visuals, clean photography, modern typography, and relatable human lifestyle imagery, so the brand feels both scientific and accessible.



Role Overview



Health & Wellness Content Editor / Social Media Creator



We are looking for a strong content editor and social media creator to help us turn simplified health and metabolic-health topics into blog articles and Instagram content.



This role is ideal for someone who is good at writing, editing, simplifying information, creating educational social posts, and working with health/wellness content.



You do not need to be a doctor, scientist, or medical researcher. However, you should be comfortable working with topics like nutrition, blood sugar, cravings, metabolic health, supplements, appetite, and behavior change.



You should be able to make content feel simple, relatable, and engaging without making exaggerated claims.



Main Responsibilities



1. Turn one topic into blog articles



For every assigned topic or subtopic, you will create a short or medium-length blog article.



The article should:



* Be easy to understand.

* Speak directly to our target persona.

* Use simple, natural language.

* Avoid overly technical explanations.

* Avoid exaggerated health or medical claims.

* Explain why the topic matters in everyday life.

* Connect the topic to cravings, food behavior, metabolic health, or healthy habits.

* Always include a natural tie-in to Nosu.



The blog article should not feel like a generic SEO article. It should feel like it was written for someone who struggles with cravings, sugar, food noise, dieting, energy dips, or feeling out of control around sweet foods.



The goal is to make the reader think:



“This explains what I experience. This brand understands me.”



2. Repurpose each topic into Instagram content



After creating the blog article, you will turn the same topic into Instagram content.



This may include:



* Educational carousel posts

* Single-image educational posts

* Myth-vs-fact posts

* Quote posts

* Problem/solution posts

* Founder/expert-style educational posts

* Relatable meme-style posts

* UGC/testimonial-inspired posts

* Product education posts

* Ingredient education posts

* Simple visual explainers

* Story slides

* Reel script ideas



Each Instagram post should focus on one topic or subtopic only.



For example:



* One post about insulin resistance

* One post about why sugar cravings happen

* One post about food noise

* One post about blood sugar spikes

* One post about how sweet taste connects to reward

* One post about how Nosu fits into a healthy routine



The posts should follow the formats used by strong DTC health and supplement brands: educational, relatable, visual, simple, and built for social media attention.



3. Write Instagram captions



For each Instagram post, you will write a caption that:



* Hooks the reader.

* Explains the idea clearly.

* Feels natural and human.

* Speaks in the language of our target audience.

* Reinforces the blog topic.

* Includes a natural tie-in to Nosu.

* Encourages saves, shares, comments, or clicks when relevant.



Captions should not feel overly salesy. They should feel educational and helpful, while still moving the reader closer to understanding why Nosu exists.



4. Collaborate on visuals



Visuals will be a collaboration.



Nosu can provide:



* Product photography

* Lifestyle images

* Brand assets

* Visual references

* Design examples

* Templates

* Creative direction



The hire can help with:



* Choosing the best visual format

* Creating simple graphics

* Building carousels in Canva, Figma, or similar tools

* Suggesting image concepts

* Adding text overlays

* Making sure posts look clean and on-brand



The added text and layout should reflect Nosu’s visual identity: clean, modern, approachable, science-backed, and visually consistent.



We want the content to feel like a real brand system, not random social posts.



5. Apply Nosu’s brand tone



All content should feel aligned with Nosu’s brand.



We want to make complex health topics understandable, but we do not want to overpromise or make medical claims.



6. Support our organic strategy



The hire should help us build an organic content system based on the strongest DTC health brands.



This includes helping us create a healthy mix of:



* Educational posts

* Category education

* Product education

* Relatable posts

* Social proof posts

* Founder/expert-style posts

* Lifestyle and habit content

* Myth-busting content

* Simple explainers

* Community/persona-led content



Over time, this content should help Nosu become a trusted educational brand in the space of sugar cravings, metabolic health, food behavior, and healthier habits.



Ideal Candidate



You may be a good fit if you:



* Have excellent English writing and editing skills.

* Can turn simple notes into strong, polished content.

* Can write in a way that speaks to a specific target audience.

* Understand how to make health content relatable.

* Have experience with wellness, nutrition, supplements, fitness, psychology, or behavior-change content.

* Can create Instagram carousels or social media posts.

* Have a good eye for clean design and visual hierarchy.

* Can use Canva, Figma, Adobe Express, or similar tools.

* Can follow brand guidelines and content structures.

* Are detail-oriented.

* Understand that health content must be careful, accurate, and not exaggerated.

* Can collaborate with a brand team on visuals and messaging.

* Can turn one topic into multiple useful content assets.



Important: What This Role Is Not



Nosu will provide the source material, simplified explanation, key takeaways, and strategic direction.



Your main job is to turn our input into:



* A clear blog article

* Strong social posts

* Great caption

* Clean, brand-aligned visual content



This is also not purely a graphic design role. Writing, editing, and simplifying information are just as important as creating the final Instagram post.



To Apply



Please send:



1. Examples of blog articles, educational content, or health/wellness writing you have created.

2. Examples of Instagram carousels, social posts, or social media graphics.

3. A short explanation of your experience with health, wellness, nutrition, supplements, fitness, or educational content.

4. A short explanation of how you would turn one topic into a blog article and Instagram post.

5. Your expected hourly rate or monthly rate.

6. Your weekly availability.

7. The tools you use for writing and design, such as Canva, Figma, Google Docs, Notion, Adobe Express, etc.

8. To confirm you’ve read this in full, please include a brief note about one of Nosu’s core values, such as behavioral change or transparency, and why it resonates with you.



Bonus points if you have experience with health brands, supplement brands, nutrition education, DTC brands, or turning complex topics into simple consumer-friendly content.

This is not a corporate video editing role. We need someone who understands performance marketing, UGC-style ads, TikTok/Reels-style editing, hooks, fast pacing, subtitles, and visual storytelling.



## Responsibilities



You will be responsible for editing short-form video ads for e-commerce products, mainly for Meta Ads.



Your tasks will include:



* Editing UGC-style video ads from raw footage

* Creating short 15–45 second ad videos

* Adding strong hooks in the first 3 seconds

* Creating multiple variations of the same video with different hooks, openings, CTAs, and structures

* Adapting winning competitor-style concepts into original creatives

* Creating videos for
, Instagram, TikTok, Reels, and Stories

* Exporting in 9:16, 4:5, and 1:1 formats when needed

* Organizing files properly in Google Drive

* Following briefs, brand guidelines, and examples provided by our team

* Delivering videos quickly and consistently every week



## What We Are Looking For



We are looking for someone who is fast, reliable, creative, and detail-oriented.



You should be comfortable editing videos for products such as beauty, wellness, fashion, shapewear, skincare, fitness, home products, or other direct-to-consumer e-commerce products.



You should understand how to make videos that feel native to social media, not overly polished or corporate.



The ideal candidate:



* Has experience editing short-form video ads

* Understands direct-response advertising

* Can create scroll-stopping openings

* Knows how to use pacing, subtitles, and visual hooks

* Can follow a brief precisely

* Can also bring creative ideas

* Works fast without sacrificing quality

* Is available full-time

* Communicates clearly in English

* Can meet deadlines consistently



## Required Skills



* Video editing for Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, Reels, or UGC content

* CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or similar tools

* Subtitle editing

* Basic sound design

* Fast-paced social media editing

* Understanding of hooks, CTAs, and ad structure

## Nice to Have



Not required, but a plus:



* Experience with e-commerce brands

* Experience with dropshipping or DTC brands

* Experience editing beauty, fashion, wellness, or fitness ads

* Experience creating static ads or simple image creatives

* Basic Photoshop or Canva skills

* Basic knowledge of Meta Ads creative testing

* Ability to analyze why an ad works or does not work



## Expected Output



We are looking for someone who can produce around:



* 2 to 4 short video ads per working day

* 40 to 80 video outputs per month, depending on complexity



Some videos will be simple variations. Others will be new creative concepts.



Quality matters more than quantity, but speed is also important.



## Work Schedule



This is a full-time remote position.



We expect good availability from Monday to Friday, clear communication, and regular updates.



You do not need to be in our time zone, but you must be responsive and organized.



## Compensation



Monthly salary depending on experience and quality:



$500 to $1,000 per month



We may also offer performance bonuses for strong work, fast delivery, and creatives that perform well in our ad accounts.



## How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:

MUST-HAVE

- Real customer support experience (e-commerce strongly preferred)

- Excellent, fluent written English

- Confident and accurate working with DeepL to communicate in German

- A solution-finder mindset — always looking for the outcome that works for BOTH the customer and the business

- Comfortable using AI tools (ChatGPT / Claude) for drafting replies

NICE-TO-HAVE (BIG PLUS)

- Understanding German yourself (MASSIVE advantage)

ONBOARDING

 templates to work with.



SCHEDULE

- Response time and reply quality (in correct German)

We are seeking a legally trained Legal Operations & Compliance Specialist to support our legal and compliance function. You will work directly with Shobhan (Legal Lead) on contract review, compliance research, regulatory filings, legal documentation, and workflow management.



This is not a purely administrative role. You will review commercial agreements, identify and summarize risks, suggest edits using established templates, conduct legal and compliance research, and help maintain the operational systems that support a growing healthcare organization.

- 2–5 years of experience in contract review, legal research, compliance, or legal operations

- Strong written and spoken English communication skills

Preferred

Examples of what we build: AI reporting systems for private equity firms · HR agents for manufacturers · sales agents for SaaS companies · chatbots and multi-tenant platforms for SMBs across healthcare, real estate, professional services, and more. The product list grows constantly — this market moves fast.



BIGGER THAN THE WORK

We treat this team like family. We want the people here to succeed in life, not just at work — we are in this for long-term relationships, not just good working ones. We are building something worth being part of, and the people who build it with us share in that success.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

• Write Python features and integrations on live client products, guided by the senior builder

• Use Cursor, Claude Code, Lovable, Bolt.new, and similar AI-native tools every day

• Work with PostgreSQL, REST APIs, and basic MCP tool development

• Integrate OpenAI and Claude APIs into product features

• Set up and work within development environments — local and cloud

• Support deployment into Azure or AWS — including basic security and environment configuration

• Test what you build, document it clearly, and hand off cleanly across time zones



CORE STACK  (70% = LET'S TALK)

Python · FastAPI or Flask · PostgreSQL basics · REST APIs · Git / GitHub · LLM APIs (OpenAI / Claude) · LangChain (learning OK) · RAG concepts · MCP basics · Cursor · Claude Code · Lovable · Bolt.new · v0 · Replit · Azure or AWS basics · Docker basics · etc.

This space moves fast. The tools we use today may not be the ones we use tomorrow — adaptability matters more than any specific tool.



WHO YOU ARE

• You have built something real — it does not need to be big. It needs to be yours.

• You use Cursor, Claude, or Lovable already — AI-assisted building is how you work

• You understand the basics of cloud deployment and want to go deeper

• You write clean, documented code that someone else can pick up

• You ask good questions, learn fast, and do not wait to be told what to do next



HOW TO APPLY

This role starts at 5 to 10+ hours per week with a clear path to full time as the company grows. Competitive rate. Performance bonuses tied to results, not just hours. We share success — as the company grows, so do the opportunities for the people who built it, including meaningful upside as we scale. Clear path toward senior builder, full cloud ownership, and solution architecture — this is a role you grow into, not out of.  read every application, but we only move forward with people who pay attention to the details. Include the word SP33D in your subject line. If you are a strong fit, we will reach out to schedule a 30-minute video call with the founder.

Computer: Reliable PC or Laptop (Core i5 processor or higher, minimum 8GB RAM).

Primary Internet: Reliable, high-speed wired connection (Fiber preferred) with at least 25 Mbps download/upload speed.

Internet Backup: A secondary backup internet source (pocket Wi-Fi, 4G/5G mobile hotspot, or secondary ISP) to ensure zero downtime.



Environment: A quiet, dedicated home office space completely free of background noise.



Shift Hours:

Full-Time: 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday.



Schedule: Fixed US Eastern Standard Time (EST) business hours (typically 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM EST).



Unmatched Compensation & Bonus Structure:

Base Salary: $600 USD per month (Paid monthly via Wise).



Permanent Signing Bonus: $10 USD upfront for every active real estate agent who signs our master TC Service Agreement (Earned immediately, whether a transaction closes or not).



Your Dual-Role Bonuses (Phase 1):

Dual-Side Closed Bonus: $120 USD ($10 onboarding + $110 closed bonus) paid upon successful closing.



Your Upgraded Lead ISA Bonuses (Phase 2 - Once Full-Time TC is Hired):



Upgraded Backend Bonus: $30 USD for every single or dual-sided transaction that successfully closes from your agent network while the new TC handles the paperwork.



This gives you a permanent, passive yield of $40 total per closed transaction ($10 upfront signing + $30 backend closed bonus) just for expanding and maintaining the network!

If you meet all the technical and compliance requirements and want a long-term career where your income matches your ambition, please reply to this posting with:

title: Video Editing_Online
description:
I run a professional education and personal brand as a Certified AI Consultant, Career-to-Creator Mentor, and Digital Strategist. My content helps experienced women turn their career expertise into digital offers and helps small business owners use AI-powered systems to work faster, market smarter, and grow with more clarity. I create content for YouTube, TikTok, Instagram Reels, and other social platforms; I shoot the footage, and you turn it into polished, professional, platform-ready videos.



I'm looking for one reliable video editor to support my channel and social media content on an ongoing part-time basis. You will own the edit end-to-end for 3-5 short videos per week and one longer-form YouTube video per month, keeping the style clean, clear, professional, and engaging for an audience of ambitious women, entrepreneurs, and small business leaders. This is a steady role for someone who can follow a style guide, take written direction, apply feedback quickly, and deliver consistent edits week after week.





What you'll do

Cut 3–5 short videos per week (90–180s) for TikTok / Reels / Shorts / X, vertical 9:16

Edit one long-form video per month (8–20 min) for YouTube, horizontal 16:9

Add captions/subtitles to a fixed style spec (single-line, short, readable on mobile)

Apply a consistent colour grade and audio clean-up (Lumetri + speech enhancement)

Cut to pacing — remove dead air, tighten gaps, keep energy high in the first 3 seconds

Add simple B-roll, text overlays, zoom punch-ins, and light motion where it serves the point

Export to platform specs and deliver organised, named files on schedule

Take direction from written notes and a style guide, and apply feedback without repeating mistakes





Must-have requirements

Proven short-form editing for social (TikTok / Reels / Shorts) — hook-first, fast pacing

Strong Adobe Premiere Pro skills (this is non-negotiable)

Comfortable with talking-head / commentary edits cut from raw footage

Clean caption work: timing, readability, no typos

Colour grading and audio repair basics (Lumetri, denoise, speech enhance)

Reliable: hits deadlines, communicates proactively, available for consistent weekly turnaround

Working computer that runs Premiere smoothly + stable internet for large file transfer

Good written English for receiving notes and asking questions







How to apply — read carefully

Applications that don't follow these steps won't be reviewed. I'm filtering for people who read instructions.



Start your message with: ADOBE PREMIERE-READY

In 3–4 sentences, tell me your experience editing short-form social video and long-form YouTube, and confirm you edit in Adobe Premiere Pro (not just CapCut).



Send links to three samples:

At least one short-form vertical video (TikTok/Reel/Short)

At least one long-form video (8+ min) cut from raw footage — tell me what was raw vs. what you added

One more of your choice



Tell me your weekly availability and your typical turnaround time for a 90-second short.

title: 3PL Operations Coordinator
description:
Remote (EST) | Full-time | Independent Contractor



About PerkUp

PerkUp is a fast-growing HR Tech startup disrupting the $242B corporate gifting industry. Our platform lets employers send high-quality swag, gifts, gift cards, and rewards to employees globally — with On Demand fulfillment, 9 warehouses across 4 continents, and 60+ HRIS integrations. To learn more, visit 
.



We are seeking a 3PL Operations Coordinator to fully own and manage the third-party logistics receiving process for all Bulk Swag projects. This role is critical to ensuring products flow smoothly from suppliers into our 3PL warehouse — from creating ASNs and ARNs to resolving receiving discrepancies. Beyond day-to-day execution, this person will be expected to identify inefficiencies and drive continuous improvements to our inbound logistics workflows. The ideal candidate will have strong Shopify experience, excellent attention to detail, and the ability to quickly pick up new tools and systems.



This role is fully remote and works on Eastern Standard Time (EST). Night shift comfort is a must, not a maybe.



Key Responsibilities



Receiving & Inbound Logistics

- ASN & ARN Management: Create and manage Advance Shipment Notices (ASNs) and Advance Receiving Notices (ARNs) for all inbound shipments across BulkSwag projects.

- 3PL Receiving Oversight: Own the full end-to-end 3PL receiving process — tracking inbound shipments, confirming receipt, and resolving discrepancies.

- Supplier & Carrier Coordination: Liaise with suppliers and freight carriers to ensure timely and accurate deliveries to the 3PL warehouse.



Inventory & Issue Resolution

- Shopify Inventory Management: Manage inventory receiving and product data in Shopify, ensuring accuracy across all systems.

- Issue Resolution: Proactively identify and resolve receiving issues such as shortages, overages, damaged goods, or mislabeled shipments.



Process Improvement & Reporting

- Process Improvement: Identify bottlenecks and inefficiencies in the receiving workflow, propose and implement solutions, and continuously refine SOPs and tooling as the business scales.

- Documentation & SOPs: Develop and maintain detailed Standard Operating Procedures for all 3PL-related processes.

- Reporting & Analytics: Generate reports on receiving timelines, discrepancy rates, and inbound logistics performance, offering actionable insights for improvement.



Collaboration

- Collaboration: Work cross-functionally with operations, sales, and customer success teams to ensure seamless fulfillment.



Qualifications



Required

- Attention to Detail: Demonstrated ability to spot errors and inconsistencies in shipping documentation and inventory data.

- Shopify Expertise: Proven experience working within Shopify; familiarity with 3rd-party Shopify apps is a plus.

- Spreadsheet Proficiency: Strong skills in Excel and/or Google Sheets for tracking shipments, reconciling quantities, and managing data.

- Shipping Documentation Knowledge: Comfortable working with BOLs, packing slips, commercial invoices, and other freight paperwork.

- Freight & Shipping Fundamentals: Understanding of LTL vs FTL shipping, carrier tracking, and basic freight coordination.

- SKU Management: Ability to maintain clean, consistent product data between Shopify and 3PL systems.

- Process-Oriented Thinker: Not just someone who follows a process — someone who questions it, finds the gaps, and makes it better.

- Quick Learner: Comfortable picking up new tools, platforms, and systems rapidly.

- Communication Skills: Strong written and verbal English language skills to effectively coordinate with suppliers, carriers, and internal teams.

- Time Management: Ability to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

- Problem-Solving Mindset: Capable of quickly diagnosing issues and implementing solutions to avoid disruptions in the receiving process.

- Ownership Mentality: Self-starter who takes full ownership of their domain without needing hand-holding.

- High Volume Tolerance: Thrives on repetitive, detail-critical process work without cutting corners.

- Reliable Work Setup: personal equipment, stable internet, and a quiet workspace for night-shift hours



Nice to Have

- 3PL / Logistics Experience: Experience with 3PL operations, warehouse coordination, or supply chain logistics is highly preferred.

- WMS Familiarity: Experience with warehouse management systems (ShipBob, ShipHero, Flexport, or similar) is a strong asset.



What We Offer

- $1,500 - $2,000/month, depending on experience.

- Up to 20 paid leave days per year, with 5 days carry forward

- Laptop provided after 30 day review

- Annual salary and performance review

- Paid access to AI tools and certification programs

- Flexible schedule for occasional personal errands

- Direct collaboration with the CEO, COO, and Operations leadership — your voice matters



Hiring Process

- Resume Submission

- Skills Assessment (TestGorilla)

- Initial Interview

- CPO Interview

- CEO Interview

- Offer

title: Experienced Documentary-Style Video Editor for Youtube
description:
# Experienced Documentary-Style Video Editor for a German YouTube Channel



**Job Posting · Freelance · Remote · Long-Term Collaboration · Starts with a Paid Test Edit**



"Long-term" "German-speaking" "Faceless YouTube" "2 Videos/Week" "Remote · Freelance" "~$50/Video"



---



## About the Channel



- A German-language "faceless" YouTube channel (no face shown) covering topics in history, sports, business, and true crime.

- Goal: 2 videos per week once the workflow is established—scaling up while maintaining consistent quality.

- The videos must perform well—not just look visually flawless. Audience retention is a must.



---



## What I Provide for the Video



- A finished German script—including instructions for B-roll footage, CTA sequences, and voiceover specifications.

- A structured briefing for the editor containing all technical specifications and style guidelines.

- ElevenLabs Voice ID—specified within the script. No API access will be shared; the Voice ID is publicly usable. - B-roll footage is not provided – you source the stock footage independently (e.g., via Pexels, Storyblocks)



---



## What You Deliver



- Production of the German voiceover using ElevenLabs (Voice ID specified in the script)

- Complete video editing – in strict adherence to the script and briefing

- Dynamic pacing: A "hook" within the first 7 seconds; cuts every 3–5 seconds

- Selection and synchronization of B-roll footage – visual content must align precisely with the narration at all times

- Animated text overlays for key facts and figures

- Color grading tailored to the specific topic

- Music selection and mixing – the voiceover must remain clearly audible at all times

- German subtitles and End Screen setup

- Export: 1920×1080, 60 fps, H.264/MP4 – Video length: 9–12 minutes



---



## Style Reference Channels



**Insolito · MrBallen · OverSimplified · Airside · World View – Documentary Style**



The editing must feel like a documentary—not like a template or a mere slideshow. Dynamic cuts, "Ken Burns" effect on still images, and meaningful synchronization of B-roll footage with the narration.



---



## Budget & Terms



| | |

|---|---|

| **Compensation** | ~$50 per video (Fixed Price) |

| **Monthly Equivalent** | ~$400–450/month (based on 2 videos per week) |

| **Revisions** | Max. 3 rounds — the initial delivery must already be of high quality |

| **Start** | Paid test edit – full briefing (PDF) will be provided | ---



## What I'm Looking For



- I'm not looking for a one-off service provider, nor am I looking for someone who needs constant micromanagement during every edit.



- I'm looking for a partner who takes ownership of the visual storytelling and has a feel for the pacing of documentaries.



- Reliability and consistency over the long term are more important to me than a mere, "polished" portfolio.



--



## Questions for Applicants



1. Do you have experience with YouTube documentary-style content? Please share your portfolio or relevant work samples.



2. Are you able to produce German-language content – including voiceover via ElevenLabs and German subtitles?



3. Is a budget of approximately $50 per video (approximately $400–$450 per month) feasible for you?



4. What is your typical editing time for a 9- to 12-minute video?



---



*Please submit your application, including your portfolio, answers to the four questions above, and your earliest possible start date.*
